name: Sarangu
body:
Sarangu
CR 8

This long-limbed beast is vaguely humanoid, covered in dark shaggy fur and with clawed hands and thick hooves for feet. Its face is bestial, with a wide fanged maw, small horns, and glowing yellow eyes.

XP 4,800
LE Large outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent, see in darkness; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 13, flat-footed 18 (+4 Dex, +9 natural, –1 size)
hp 115 (10d10+60)
Fort +9, Ref +11, Will +8
DR 5/good; Immune fire, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10; SR 19

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 claws +15 (1d6+6), 2 hooves +10 (1d6+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks bag of entrapment, trample (1d6+9, DC 21)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 10th)

At will—charm person, detect magic, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)
1/day—fear, summon (level 5, 1 sarangu or 6 lemures, 50%)

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 18, Con 22, Int 14, Wis 13, Cha 18
Base Atk +10; CMB +16; CMD 30
Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved GrappleB, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lunge, Power Attack
Skills Bluff +17, Climb +14, Diplomacy +13, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (planes) +15, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +13 (+17 in dim light or darkness)
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bag of Entrapment (Su)

When a sarangu pins a Medium or smaller creature, it stuffs the creature into its special bag as a free action.

Once a creature is pinned in this way, the sarangu no longer has the grappled condition. The creature in the bag has total cover from all creatures and they have total cover from it (other than dealing with the grapple by the sarangu). A creature beginning its turn in the bag is shaken for 1 minute (DC 19 Will negates) and must save again each round at the beginning of its turn. If a second save is failed, the creature is paralyzed for 1 minute and need not make further saving throws until the paralyzed condition ends. This is a fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

A creature in the bag can try to cut its way free with any light slashing or piercing weapon (AC 14, hp 12), or it can just try to escape the pin. If a bagged creature cuts its way out, the bag is broken and unusable. A sarangu can repair a ruptured bag as a full-round action.

ECOLOGY

Environment any urban
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Sarangus are the slave-takers of the netherworld, prowling the darkened streets of the world by night and seeking lonely travelers or especially children who have stayed up past their bedtime to capture. Their eyes gleam with a lambent glow and, combined with their dark fur, often seem almost disembodied when they creep through the shadows. Each sarangu carries a large sack woven of the skins of animals and humanoids alike, which it uses to ensnare their prey. Once they have a victim, they will drag them off to their infernal allies for their unspeakable purposes. Those taken by the “sack man” are rarely ever seen again.
